newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble flat vs dlr, matching unchanged C.bank rate.
newsitem.headline: Rouble flat vs dlr, matching unchanged C.bank rate.

text.p: The rouble was virtually unchanged against the dollar on Thursday as the central bank preserved its official rate for Thursday and Friday at Wednesday's levels, while demand for rouble funds rose, traders said.
rouble/dollar Feb 6 midday Feb 6 early Feb 5 close
"The market is quiet as it knows that the central bank wants to keep the rouble at mid-week levels," said one trader.

"Even if there were a slight upward dollar trend it would be minimised by demand for rouble funds, which rose as banks needed cash for compulsory reserves with the central bank," said Andrei Trebumskikh, chief dealer at United Investment Bank.
Traders said they expected a gentle dollar rise later this month under control of the central bank, which wants the rouble depreciation match inflation levels.
Inflation quickened to 2.3 percent in January, while the rouble depreciated by 1.3 percent.
"The government is likely to force inflation down a bit and to raise the dollar at the same time," Trebumskikh said.
